notes: Endorsement link expiry (2026-10-31, security audit 2026-10-29 finding 22; owner decision 2026-10-31: "Endorsement links: how long they stay valid. - 30 days. If an endorsement is resent it refreshes the links"). Public endorsement links never expired. The accepted check-endorsement.mjs bytes stamp check_endorsements.token_expires_at and check_payees.endorsement_token_expires_at (existing columns; no SQL change) to send time + 30 days (ENDORSEMENT_LINK_TTL_DAYS) on send_endorsement_request, keeping the same token, so a resend restarts the 30 days for every link already sent. get_endorsement_data, submit_endorsement and reject_endorsement refuse a link at or past that time with 410 link_expired before any write; a row sent before the stamp existed (token_expires_at NULL) runs 30 days from request_sent_at when it can be read. The SPA Endorse page already shows the response error text; no SPA change. live_sha256 provenance: supersedes_unapplied_manifest: no production apply of the release 2026-10-17 accepted bytes (85f4bec4) is recorded, so live_sha256 stays that manifest's live value (7c6ae301, the 2026-10-11 live production bundle snapshot), which must be confirmed by a read-only production inspect before any apply. sql_before stays null.
